source_quote: Assignment on M&A: the Partner may not assign the agreement without the Company's prior written consent, but the Company may assign the agreement (in whole or in part) to an affiliate/subsidiary, to an acquirer of all or substantially all of the relevant business/assets (by merger, asset sale, or otherwise), or as part of an internal reorganization, with notice to the Partner. No Partner consent is required for a Company-side assignment on this basis.
